calls.title: Balkan and James Shannon
calls.summary: The meeting focused on Airalo's evaluation of GrowthBook as a potential enhancement to their experimentation capabilities, currently limited by Unleash. Balkan Misirli highlighted the need for product managers and semi-technical users to independently conduct 20 to 50 experiments monthly, integrating with BigQuery for data analysis. The team discussed GrowthBook's modular architecture, allowing it to coexist with Unleash while offering features like sticky bucketing for consistency across devices. Additionally, integration with dbt for metrics governance was emphasized, along with robust SDK functionality for capturing experiment data. The pricing model, starting at $75,000 annually for 60 experiments, was also reviewed, along with plans for further collaboration and a demo session in two weeks.
calls.keywords: Feature Flagging, Experimentation Platform, GrowthBook, Unleash, BigQuery Integration, Pricing Model
calls.action_items:

**James Shannon**

Confirm and clarify GrowthBook’s capabilities related to one-click promotion of experiments to 100% rollout and reply with documented solutions/examples via email (36:30)
Send formal pricing details and package summary to Balkan Misirli (41:10)
Support scheduling and delivery of a full demo to Airalo’s broader team after holiday period (42:05)
